snippet.title: AirRaDe Air (Trial ver.) - 41.7mil, Misuzu (WinXP to Win10 two-computer capture chain test)
snippet.description:
Testing out a rebuild of my old Windows XP PC outputting its video to my main PC, via the [Open Source Scan Convertor - DVDO iScan VP30 - AverMedia Live Gamer 4K] video capture chain. Audio is output to the VP30 via a headphone-to-two-phono cable.

Testing everything out with the demo for Studio Siesta's old doujin shooter AirRaDe Air, which is a horizontal scroller based on the Air anime. This game actually doesn't run very well at all on Windows 10, as it has an uncapped framerate and on modern systems runs at lightspeed, so it's the perfect candidate to test out the Windows XP PC and its capabilities. It's also an excuse to record my old replay on the demo for posterity.
